entries.title: Hebrews 6:1
segments: ¶Therefore, leaving the discussion of the elementary [principles] of Christ, let us go on to perfection, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works and of faith toward God,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:2
segments: of the doctrine of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:3
segments: And this we will do if God permits.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:4
segments: For [it is] impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted the heavenly gift, and have become partakers of the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:5
segments: and have tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:6
segments: if they fall away, to renew them again to repentance, since they crucify again for themselves the Son of God, and put [Him] to an open shame.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:7
segments: For the earth which drinks in the rain that often comes upon it, and bears herbs useful for those by whom it is cultivated, receives blessing from God;

entries.title: Hebrews 6:8
segments: but if it bears thorns and briars, [it is] rejected and near to being cursed, whose end [is] to be burned.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:9
segments: ¶But, beloved, we are confident of better things concerning you, yes, things that accompany salvation, though we speak in this manner.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:10
segments: For God [is] not unjust to forget your work and labor of love which you have shown toward His name, [in that] you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:11
segments: And we desire that each one of you show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope until the end,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:12
segments: that you do not become sluggish, but imitate those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:13
segments: For when God made a promise to Abraham, because He could swear by no one greater, He swore by Himself,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:14
segments: saying, "Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you."

entries.title: Hebrews 6:15
segments: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:16
segments: For men indeed swear by the greater, and an oath for confirmation [is] for them an end of all dispute.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:17
segments: Thus God, determining to show more abundantly to the heirs of promise the immutability of His counsel, confirmed [it] by an oath,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:18
segments: that by two immutable things, in which it [is] impossible for God to lie, we might have strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold of the hope set before [us].

entries.title: Hebrews 6:19
segments: This [hope] we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and which enters the Presence [behind] the veil,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:20
segments: where the forerunner has entered for us, [even] Jesus, having become High Priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
